summary: Kerb beside open park on Townley Street, where other cars park; houses across the road.
reasons: Backs onto park, homes across road

best_section.where: Townley Street west kerb beside the park, south of the Carmody Road corner

drivers.seclusion: Park on the west side; houses only across the road, 19-20 m from this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Ordinary two-way street; parked cars show the kerb is used, and the grass verge is wide.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street off a signalled junction.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on this kerb in the 2022 image. 2P signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 6% grade along the section
Houses face the section across the road
sun_shade: Open grass to the west gives afternoon sun; park trees shade the northern end.
